name: popover
title: Popover 弹出层
description: 点击触发的小浮层，展示附加内容或简短表单。

whenToUse: 点击后显示少量内容或控件
accessibility: 由按钮触发，Esc 关闭并归还焦点
responsive: 窄屏下自动翻转位置并保持在视口内

files.content:
# Popover 设计规范

- 用于点击后出现、可以操作的轻量面板，如小表单、筛选、选择器；纯文字提示用 Tooltip，一组操作命令用 Dropdown Menu，较长流程用 Dialog。
- 打开它的按钮通过 `Popover.Trigger` 的 `{#snippet child({ props })}` 渲染 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）。
- 面板有标题时用 `Popover.Header`、`Popover.Title`、`Popover.Description`，不要自己写加粗文字。
- 位置用 `side`、`align`、`sideOffset` 属性；面板会自动翻转并保持在视口内，不要用 `class` 写定位。
- 工具栏的分组设置用 `appearance="options"`，由内容组提供 8 × 16 px 内边距，32 px 行容纳紧凑选择器、复选框和简短标签。组之间用 Separator。面板按锚点和视口缩小，长内容在面板内滚动。
- 内容组件自带内边距时（如 Command、Calendar）可给默认 `Popover.Content` 加 `p-0`；需要与触发按钮同宽时用 `w-(--bits-popover-anchor-width)`，其他宽度用已有尺寸档位。
- 搜索选择（Combobox）用 Popover + Command，日期选择用 Popover + Calendar，照对应文档的组合写法，不要另做一个下拉组件。
- 面板里的操作完成后需要关闭时，用 `bind:open` 设为 `false` 或用 `Popover.Close`；关闭后焦点回到触发按钮。
- 面板默认使用 12 px 圆角、实色底和 10 px 内边距。工作区筛选、属性和对话历史可用 `appearance="surface"` 应用工作区的 Command 行密度。Command 搜索输入在打开时聚焦，关闭后回到触发器。

<script lang="ts">
	import { PopoverClose as SdkClose } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/popover";
	import type { StyleProperties } from "svelte-toolbelt";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef, toStyleString } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		style,
		child,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "style" | "children"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		style?: StyleProperties | string | null;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLButtonElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkClose data-slot="popover-close" style={toStyleString(style)} {...restProps}>
	{#snippet render({ props })}
		{@const attributes = { ...props, ...refAttachment }}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkClose>

{#snippet render({ props, state })} {@const attributes = { ...props, ...(hasExplicitAriaLabel ? { "aria-labelledby": undefined } : {}), "data-slot": resolvedDataSlot, "data-side": (props["data-side"] as string | undefined) ?? side, "data-align": (props["data-align"] as string | undefined) ?? align, "data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed", ...refAttachment, }} {#if child} {@render child({ props: attributes, open: state.open })} {:else}
{@render children?.()}
{/if} {/snippet}
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

	let {
		children,
	}: {
		to?: string | Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		disabled?: boolean;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();
</script>

{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { PopoverTrigger as SdkTrigger, type PopoverController } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/popover";
	import type { StyleProperties } from "svelte-toolbelt";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import { bindElementRef, toStyleString } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		style,
		disabled,
		focusableWhenDisabled,
		payload,
		shortcut,
		controller,
		child,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "style" | "children"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		style?: StyleProperties | string | null;
		disabled?: boolean;
		focusableWhenDisabled?: boolean;
		payload?: unknown;
		shortcut?: string;
		controller?: PopoverController<unknown>;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLButtonElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkTrigger
	{disabled}
	{focusableWhenDisabled}
	{payload}
	{shortcut}
	{controller}
	data-slot="popover-trigger"
	class={cn(className)}
	style={toStyleString(style)}
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			"data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed",
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkTrigger>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Popover as SdkPopover,
		type PopoverController,
		type PopoverDismissReason,
		type PopoverOpenChangeReason,
		type PopoverPayloadChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/popover";
	import type { ChangeDetails, DismissAttemptDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { POPOVER_POLICY_KEY, type PopoverDismissPolicy } from "./context.js";

	let {
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		modal,
		openOnHover,
		delay,
		closeDelay,
		presentation,
		controller,
		dismissible,
		container,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		onPayloadChange,
		onDismissAttempt,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		modal?: boolean | "trap-focus";
		openOnHover?: boolean;
		delay?: number;
		closeDelay?: number;
		presentation?: "auto" | "popover" | "sheet";
		controller?: PopoverController<unknown>;
		dismissible?: boolean;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<PopoverOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		onPayloadChange?: (
			payload: unknown,
			details: ChangeDetails<PopoverPayloadChangeReason>
		) => void;
		onDismissAttempt?: (details: DismissAttemptDetails<PopoverDismissReason>) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy: PopoverDismissPolicy = {};
	setContext(POPOVER_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: PopoverDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
	});

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<PopoverOpenChangeReason>) {
		if (!next) {
			if (
				(details.reason === "outside-press" || details.reason === "focus-out") &&
				(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (
				details.reason === "escape-key" &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (details.reason === "outside-press" && policy.onInteractOutside) {
				const event = new CustomEvent("interactOutside", {
					cancelable: true,
					detail: { originalEvent: details.event },
				});
				policy.onInteractOutside(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (details.reason === "escape-key" && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				// @ui-sdk/core calls preventDefault() on the native Escape event before
				// firing onOpenChange; dispatch a fresh cancelable event so callers opt in
				// explicitly when preventing dismissal.
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			// Prevent a consumed Escape from bubbling to an outer legacy Dialog/Sheet.
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkPopover
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	{modal}
	{openOnHover}
	{delay}
	{closeDelay}
	{presentation}
	{controller}
	{dismissible}
	{container}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
	{onPayloadChange}
	{onDismissAttempt}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkPopover>
